summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of FORGE v1.1 (auth + streaming + multi-file + versions + export). Rewrote backend pytest suite for new auth-protected API: 24/24 tests pass including auth (me/logout/migrate), project CRUD with user isolation, non-stream + SSE streaming generation via Claude Sonnet 4.5, version snapshots, rollback, export zip structure, and delete cascade. Frontend: login page renders, unauth /  /login redirect works, cookie-based auth loads landing with user menu and 4 templates, new project + workspace navigation, streaming chat shows progressive bubble with cursor, code mode shows file tabs (App.jsx tab present), Version History modal opens, lists versions, rollback succeeds with toast and reloads files, export endpoint returns valid 200 application/zip via direct fetch.

integration_issues.issue: After a successful generation, the sonner success toast 'Code generated' renders at top-right in the same area as the versions-btn / export-btn / user-menu, and on smaller viewports may visually overlap or briefly intercept clicks. With force=True it works, but real users on narrower screens could miss-click. Suggest moving toasts to bottom-right or auto-dismissing faster (default sonner is fine, just reposition).

action_items: (Optional) Reposition sonner toaster to bottom-right (or bottom-center) so transient toasts don't overlap workspace header buttons.

(Optional) Persistent issue from iter 1 still applies: PreviewPanel.copyCode() should wrap navigator.clipboard in try/catch with toast fallback to avoid React dev-mode error overlay in restricted iframe contexts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py adapt_app_for_export() removes a 'render(<App />)' line via regex; if the assistant produces e.g. 'render(<App  />);' with extra whitespace inside <App  />, current regex r'<App\s*/>' covers it, but if the file ends without trailing newline the MULTILINE anchor still matches — looks ok. Edge: if the file has multiple render() calls, only the first MULTILINE-line-matching one is removed. Minor.

server.py /api/auth/session sets the session cookie with samesite='none' and secure=True. Good for cross-site, but in browser tests we had to inject it via context.add_cookies. Document this for FE devs.
server.py _save_assistant_response: 20-version retention deletes by id from the > 20 slice ordered by created_at DESC — correct.
server.py logger.exception used inside generate_code_stream; SSE error events surfaced to client correctly. Good.

Workspace.jsx handleExport: uses fetch with credentials:'include' and no Authorization header — fine for cookie auth, but if a future migration moves to header-only Bearer this would silently break. Consider adding Bearer header alongside.
VersionHistory.jsx: missing apiClient error visibility — toast.error is generic 'Failed to load versions' and doesn't surface 401/403. Acceptable.

App.js (router): synchronous hash check pattern is brittle; if user lands at /project/:id with hash instead of /, AuthCallback would not run. Verify the OAuth redirect_uri always points to / (it does per AuthCallback design). OK.
test_credentials: Seeded directly in MongoDB collections users + user_sessions via pymongo in setup_module. Tokens prefixed with TEST_session_*. Cleaned up in teardown_module. /app/auth_testing.md documents the mongosh equivalent.
seed_data_creation: Tests create 2 users (USER_A, USER_B) + sessions in users/user_sessions. All artifacts cleaned in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully stable. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_api.py -v` (uses pymongo + REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). The export download via Playwright's page.expect_download did NOT trigger when clicking export-btn (programmatic blob:URL anchor click — known Playwright quirk in some browsers/headless modes), but a direct in-page fetch confirmed the API returns 200 application/zip with valid bytes (1929B for an empty App.jsx). The functionality is correct in real browsers; if you need to assert download in Playwright, intercept the network response instead of expect_download. Streaming endpoint returns SSE events 'user' → many 'chunk' → final 'done' with files/code; ~7-15s end-to-end. Versions retention works (cap 20).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no live bugs found in v1.1. The previous iteration_1 PreviewPanel.copyCode clipboard bug remains untouched (was MEDIUM priority and not part of v1.1 scope).
